_comment: Abuse-case register for issue #41. status: automated (a test in apps/api/src/threat-model.test.ts whose title starts with the id), requires-live-service (cannot be tested until the named Developer A service exists), gap (a missing control found by this review). matrixApproved mirrors docs/project/contracts/capability-matrix.json and must stay false until issue #6 is genuinely approved.

cases.title: Unauthenticated or forged session reaches a private route
cases.residualRisk: Session strength, rotation and idle/absolute timeouts are tested in packages/auth; a stolen valid cookie is a valid session until revoked.

cases.title: OIDC login abuse (state, nonce, replay, missing MFA)
cases.residualRisk: Covered by apps/api/src/auth-routes.test.ts against a local fake identity provider; behaviour against the real institutional provider is untested (needs the provider configuration).

cases.title: Cross-site request forgery on a write
cases.residualRisk: Token-based protection only; SameSite cookie attributes are set by the auth router and were not re-tested in a real browser here.

cases.title: Reading another researcher's or another study's record (IDOR); client-chosen study or owner
cases.residualRisk: Only routes declared in a test table were exercised; every real route must resolve its resource from server data, which validateRoutes cannot check (code review needed per route).

cases.title: Privilege escalation: wrong role, inactive user, expired grant, untrained collector
cases.residualRisk: Matches whatever the PROPOSED matrix says; a wrong matrix would be enforced faithfully (issue #6 approval pending).

cases.title: Valid authentication used to publish or approve one's own work, or work with unknown authorship
cases.residualRisk: Independence is checked per action by author id; collusion between two accounts and shared accounts are not detectable by software.

cases.title: Raw interview position or private field reaches the public API, bundle or map
cases.residualRisk: Checked against the synthetic mock and the contract validator; the real projection job and database views (#81) must pass the same checks before any claim of production safety.

cases.title: Restricted export without purpose or by the wrong role
cases.residualRisk: Purpose approval is asserted by the caller in the authorizer; the two-person approval and download rules are in packages/exports (model only, no storage or worker).

cases.title: Malformed, oversized or hostile input; stack traces and internals in error responses
cases.residualRisk: FOUND: Express's default error handler printed stack traces and file paths outside production. apps/api/src/safe-errors.ts fixes it for the apps that mount it; Developer A must mount notFound and safeErrors in the real server (see integration handoff). Body size uses Express's 100 kb default; per-route limits are not set.

cases.title: Learning whether a private record exists from the response
cases.residualRisk: Status and body are identical for missing and forbidden records; response timing differences were not measured.

cases.title: Missing or content-leaking audit trail
cases.residualRisk: FOUND: requests without a valid session are rejected by requireSession before the permission hook, so unauthenticated probing of private routes is not written to the permission audit (login attempts are covered by the auth events of #39). Audit events carry identifiers only; tamper-evidence and retention of the audit store belong to #39 and the database role tests.

cases.title: Brute force and request flooding (login, search, export)
cases.residualRisk: No rate limiting or lockout exists anywhere in apps/api. Login throttling, per-user and per-IP limits on private routes and on the public API are needed before field use or public launch (handoff item for Developer A, #81/#40).

cases.title: Upload threats: polyglot files, oversized uploads, path tricks, malware, EXIF leakage
cases.residualRisk: No upload endpoint exists (#60). The media rights model (packages/place-content) assumes quarantine, re-encoding and EXIF stripping but cannot test them.

cases.title: Cross-site scripting through stored text shown on public pages
cases.residualRisk: Public pages render API text through React text nodes; the search test and place-name tests cover hostile strings. A strict Content-Security-Policy header is not set by any server yet.

cases.title: Consent bypass: collecting or using data without recorded, current consent
cases.residualRisk: Consent records (#37) and enforcement on raw endpoints (#38) do not exist. The rules model (packages/field-flow) and aggregation (packages/analytics) exclude non-consented data, but nothing server-side enforces it yet. This is the most important open item.

cases.title: Private responses cached by browsers or proxies
cases.residualRisk: createApp sets Cache-Control: no-store on everything; a router mounted outside createApp would not inherit it.

cases.title: Raw interview and GPS endpoint protection
cases.residualRisk: Endpoints (#38) are not implemented; the generic private-route checks above are the pattern they must follow.

cases.title: Secrets in configuration, logs or bundles
cases.residualRisk: Bundle secret scan and config loading tests exist (scripts/scan_secrets.py, packages/config); secret management for staging/production (#40, #124) is not provisioned.
